projects.title: Personal Website
descriptions: This is my first React project so far, and while it is still a work in progress, it marks an important milestone in my React development journey.

The project was built using React and Vite, with styling handled through CSS Modules. It was created as part of my first React course on Udemy, where I focused on modern front-end development practices and strengthening my component-based architecture skills.
The JSX structure and component logic were developed by me, while AI tools were used to support the CSS styling.

projects.title: Egg Fella Music Bot
descriptions: This project is a Discord music bot built with Node.js, discord.js v14, and DisTube. It was created as a way to explore real-time bot development, voice channel integration, and command-driven interactions.
The bot supports music playback through commands like play, skip, queue, shuffle, replace, and push, with support for YouTube and Spotify sources through DisTube plugins.

I used this project to strengthen my understanding of asynchronous event handling, queue management, and working with third-party APIs. Development began in 2023 and was paused in 2025 as Discord’s changing platform support made this kind of bot less practical to maintain.

projects.title: Monsters vs Kingsmen
descriptions: A Java-based Spigot plugin for Minecraft 1.16.5 that turns a server lobby into a class-based roleplaying battle game with dragons, custom player classes, and automated world generation.
The plugin uses the Bukkit/Spigot API to manage events, player abilities, and match state. It was developed as a larger multiplayer project from around October 2020 through May 2021.

Players choose classes from custom spawn eggs, fight a player-controlled dragon, then return as monsters if they die. It was built around multiplayer balance, event handling, and custom player abilities.
